# Dispatch

> Dispatch is a private webmail workspace for connected email accounts.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://mail.despical.dev/): Overview of the workspace.
- [Features](https://mail.despical.dev/features): Mailbox and message features.
- [Security](https://mail.despical.dev/security): Account and message protections.
- [Contact](https://mail.despical.dev/contact): Support and feedback.
- [Privacy policy](https://mail.despical.dev/privacy-policy): Data and cookie practices.
- [Terms of service](https://mail.despical.dev/terms-of-service): Service terms.

Mailboxes, account settings, and administration require sign-in. Dispatch does not publish an agent tool or public mail API.
